about: Supplement to fleetlab/faults/curves.json, measured by fleetlab.worlds.supplement (robots-75s.2): libero_object points and the interaction pairs' joint points, X-VLA fp16_res32, four batch rows, the fleet's check (placed), 100 episodes per point paired with healthy twins of the same suite (tasks 0-9 by start states 0-9, world w91). role: effect (fewer successes beyond noise, exact McNemar p < 0.05), decoy (no change beyond noise and a two-point loss excluded), small_cause (neither). singles and interaction: only when healthy, A, B and A+B were measured on identical attempts in this run; absent when those singles were not run.

task_calibration.method: Exact recorded cohorts, grouped by task; healthy twins matched by simulator and policy identity; duplicate attempts counted once. No screening data.
